title: Algebraic Structure and Orthogonality Properties of Rational Polynomial Phase Rings on Discrete Lattices
summary: We formalize the algebraic structure of rational polynomial phase sequences (discrete chirps) over the integer lattice $\mathbb{Z}$. By constructing a convolution algebra generated by polynomial phases with coefficients in $\mathbb{Q}$, we establish a rigorous operational calculus for discrete difference equations. We prove an exact orthogonality relation for these sequences over finite periodic windows, yielding a generalized discrete Fourier isometry.
